objective: Give a person on the Cash page the three opportunity transitions the server already implements and nothing calls: reoffer, exhaust and archive. POST /api/cash/opportunities/:opportunityId/:action (server/routes/cash.ts ~774-892) handles `reoffer` (~845-866: requires toProjectId and reason, authorizes the destination through requireProject and refuses a project not running Cash Mode; `reoffer` in server/services/cash/opportunities.ts ~722-771 accepts only a DECLINED opportunity), `exhaust` (~867-876; server ~774-801, refuses a second exhaust) and `archive` (~877-886; server ~804-830, from any non-archived state, reason required). client/src/lib/cashApi.ts already has a generic `act` (~787-794), but the `Actions` component in client/src/russell/Cash.tsx (~2337-2500) offers only ready, decline, execute, deliver and collect, so a declined opening can never be offered to another operation, a finished one can never be marked exhausted, and nothing can be archived — while Cash.tsx already renders `exhaustedAt`/`exhaustedReason` (~2095-2100) and plain-event labels for CASH_OPPORTUNITY_ARCHIVED and CASH_OPPORTUNITY_REOFFERED (~2774-2775) that only these transitions can produce.
expectedOutcome: `Actions` in Cash.tsx offers **Archive** (asks for a reason) on every opportunity that is not ARCHIVED, **Mark exhausted** (asks for a reason) on one whose exhaustedAt is null, and **Offer to another operation** only on a DECLINED one, asking for a reason and a destination chosen from the projects the person can read (the existing projects list the client already fetches from GET /api/projects, excluding the opportunity's own project). All three go through `CashApi.act` with exactly the body the route reads ({reason} or {toProjectId, reason}). A refusal — including 'That operation is not running Cash Mode, so it takes no openings.' — is rendered in the server's words, the reason input keeps what was typed on failure, and the section re-reads the view on success. Nothing is removed from the page: an archived or exhausted opening stays listed with its reason.
nonGoals: Changing reoffer, exhaust, archiveOpportunity, decline or any state machine in server/services/cash/**.
Adding a route, a listing endpoint for destinations, a column or a migration.
An unarchive or un-exhaust transition (none exists on the server).
Deleting or hiding any opportunity, event or card fact.
Offering these controls to a SHARED-scope reader.

acceptanceConditions.statement: A test drives the Cash section over the real routes and database: archiving an opportunity with a reason moves its row to ARCHIVED with archived_reason set, a CASH_OPPORTUNITY_ARCHIVED event exists, and the opportunity is still rendered with that reason.
Marking an opportunity exhausted with a reason sets exhausted_at and exhausted_reason, and the control is no longer offered for it on the next render.
The Offer control is rendered only for a DECLINED opportunity; for a DISCOVERED, READY or EXECUTING one it is absent, asserted in the rendered document.

Offering a declined opportunity to a readable project that is not running Cash Mode renders the server's refusal verbatim, creates no opportunity in that project, and leaves the typed reason in the input.

Each control posts only the fields the route reads ({reason}, or {toProjectId, reason}); a test inspects the request bodies and finds no other key, and a reason left empty keeps the Confirm button disabled so no request is made.
A SHARED-scope member's page renders none of the three controls, and a WORKER principal posting any of the three actions is refused with no row changed.
The existing tests/cashSection.test.tsx and tests/cashBrowserToDatabase.test.ts still pass and the repository typechecks.

rollbackRequirement: Discard the branch. Client and test changes only; every transition the new controls perform is an existing guarded server transition that keeps the row and its reason.
